name: Circuit Analysis II: Polevane
subtitle: 3D Circuit Analysis Labs
shortDescription: Adaptive Circuit Analysis II course: tuner helix, pole landscape, rail ringing, three-phase field and Smith helix in five 3D labs. Study aid only.
longDescription:
Circuit Analysis II: Polevane takes the second undergraduate circuits course (AC steady state, resonance, Laplace-domain circuits, transients, frequency response, two-ports and three-phase) and puts each idea on a real object you can turn in three dimensions. It is for study only and is not for real circuit or electrical design, or for mains or electrical safety decisions.

### Start From A Real Object
A radio tuning dial. An audio resonator. A phone-charger power rail. A motor supply. A line filter. Each opens as a 3D scene with the governing formula and its live number drawn over the picture, so you see what a change in resistance, damping or frequency does before you compute it.

### Five 3D Labs
- Tuner Helix: voltage and current phasors wound along time inside a projection box; look down the time axis to see the phasor diagram and watch the helices lock at resonance.
- Pole Landscape: the magnitude of H(s) over the s-plane as a coloured surface with draggable poles and a zero; the cut along the jw axis is the Bode curve.
- Rail Ringing: the state trajectory of a switched RLC rail with a tolerance window, with overshoot and settling read out live.
- Three-Phase Field: three rotating phasors build the stator field; add imbalance and watch the neutral current and the field locus.
- Smith Helix: a reflection-coefficient helix over frequency on the Smith disc, an LC ladder cascade, and the gain on the wall.
Citations open in an in-app window with back and open-in-browser.

### Practice At Your Level And Length
160 questions across 14 topics. Pick the length (5, 10, 20, 40 or your own number) and the level, from beginner to research-level, or let the adaptive path choose. The numeric items were recomputed with a second numerical program, and each shows a worked solution. Works offline, with text size controls on every screen.

### Free, With Optional Ad Removal
Every lesson, lab and exam is free. Ads appear only at natural breaks outside exams, and a video earns 30 ad-free minutes. An optional monthly subscription removes ads.
